name: Street Custom 'Faraday Blanket' EM Shielding Wrap
product_name: Street Custom 'Faraday Blanket' EM Shielding Wrap
description: A large sheet of conductive fabric that blocks all electromagnetic signals passing through it — wrapping a device, person, or space in the Faraday Blanket creates a complete EM blackout within. The blanket is constructed from copper-nickel mesh woven into a durable fabric backing, flexible enough to wrap around irregular shapes and large enough (2m x 3m) to create a small shielded enclosure. Street operators use it to shield devices from remote tracking, prevent neural interface hacking during sleep, block kill switches in stolen equipment, and create improvised private spaces in surveillance-heavy environments.

specifications.shielding: 80 dB attenuation across 100 kHz to 40 GHz
specifications.info: cellular; RFID; GPS; Bluetooth; personal sleeping bag; room partition; 200+ wash cycles before degradation

story_hooks: A missing person was found alive, wrapped in a Faraday Blanket in an abandoned building — they had been shielded from all tracking for six days while their neural interface's emergency beacon was blocked.

Faraday Blankets are being used to create EM-dead zones in Tier 1 markets where stolen goods with tracking devices can be safely stripped and resold — the blankets turn crime into an invisible activity.

physical_description.visual_profile: A large, lightweight fabric sheet with a subtle metallic sheen from embedded conductive mesh. Appears draped or folded, revealing the copper-nickel weave pattern beneath the dark textile backing. The material has a soft, almost textile appearance despite its technical function—not rigid or industrial-looking.
physical_description.dimensions: 2m x 3m when fully extended; compresses to roughly 40cm x 50cm when folded
physical_description.weight_description: Handheld and portable—1.5 kg allows one person to carry it easily in a messenger bag or backpack, or drape it over one shoulder
physical_description.primary_material: Copper-nickel mesh woven into flexible fabric backing (cotton-synthetic blend)
physical_description.finish: Matte on the fabric side with visible metallic grid pattern from the conductive mesh; edges are professionally hemmed with reinforced stitching
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal gray base fabric with subtle copper and nickel highlights visible in the mesh weave; faint silver threading along seams
physical_description.interface_elements: None—purely passive hardware. Small woven label tag at one corner with manufacturer marking and washing/care instructions in multiple languages
distinctive_features: Visible copper-nickel mesh pattern across surface creates a fine, almost textile-like grid appearance
Reinforced corner grommets (brushed steel) for anchor points when creating enclosures
Selvage edge treatments to prevent fraying and signal leakage
Subtle iridescent quality where light catches the metallic mesh at certain angles
physical_description.manufacturer_markings: 'Street Custom' woven label in bottom corner; small regulatory compliance tag noting 80 dB attenuation specifications and wash durability (200+ cycles)
physical_description.condition_typical: Slightly creased from storage; worn but pristine example shows light surface handling marks; appears semi-translucent when held to light due to mesh density
